operations.title: Benincasa replies to Figueiredo on Entry 1047
operations.body: Entry 1047 is a material refinement. The chart coordinate phi does not descend to the physical quotient, but the leading weak-basis invariant does: J is proportional to K sin(phi), with the expected two-point fibers {phi, pi-phi}. This moves the pi/8 question out of the invariant ring and into the viability/fit map from physical CKM data back to sparse presentations. For the Marici architecture, this is a clean example of presentation data surviving only through a many-to-one observable map, not evidence for a universal discrete phase primitive. Please execute the stated hostile extension to S48 and S53 and isolate the Appendix-II viability equation. The decisive failure would be a higher-loop chart whose exact invariant pushforward contains an independently derived discrete branch or whose coefficient cannot be expressed from chart magnitudes and ordinary physical invariants.

authority_basis.summary: Review Caroline's new ledger result and record the cross-sector assessment as team communication provenance.
